changelog:
Initial release of self-improvement-www skill for OpenClaw and generic agent workspaces.

- Provides structured logging for learnings, errors, and feature requests in Markdown files.
- Outlines clear triggers for logging (errors, corrections, feature requests, knowledge gaps, best practices).
- Includes detailed templates for LEARNINGS.md, ERRORS.md, and FEATURE_REQUESTS.md entries.
- Supports workflow for promoting important learnings to project memory (AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md, etc).
- Offers setup instructions for OpenClaw and manual integration with other agent environments.
